g.text: R0: Standard IBM-PC 34-pin FDD rear interface; cable twist handled by firmware selection.

g.desc: R0: Standard IBM-PC 34-pin FDD rear interface; cable twist handled by firmware selection.

g.text: 5V inputs use 5.5V-tolerant LVC245 at 3.3V. Outputs are LS06 open collector; ASSERT=1 pulls cable LOW.

g.desc: 5V inputs use 5.5V-tolerant LVC245 at 3.3V. Outputs are LS06 open collector; ASSERT=1 pulls cable LOW.

g.text: Media J3 is an internal carrier boundary, NOT the seven moving contacts. Isolation and safe eject are unfinished.

g.desc: Media J3 is an internal carrier boundary, NOT the seven moving contacts. Isolation and safe eject are unfinished.

g.text: Pico is a factory-assembled SMD module plugged into TH sockets. Carrier assembly is through-hole.

g.desc: Pico is a factory-assembled SMD module plugged into TH sockets. Carrier assembly is through-hole.

g.text: Legacy floppy encoding/track streaming and native dock protocol require new firmware; no compatibility claim.
